messages.content: The Andaz pre-arrival summary is wrong. The room and breakfast package are there, but Monday's prepaid spa appointment is missing, and it shows an airport transfer request we never made.

I’ll reconcile it against the confirmations. I have two massages on Monday at 3:00 p.m., with $286.70 paid and $286.70 due at the spa. The airport transfer should be removed. What arrival time should the resort note for Thursday?
Put 5:00 p.m. We land at 2:05, but I don’t want the room booking touched just to add an arrival note. It must stay refundable through February 13 at 6:00 p.m. local time.
Understood. I’ll request an arrival note only, with no modification to the rate plan, deposit, dates, or cancellation terms. I’ll also ask for a corrected written itinerary and a balance breakdown.
Please do that, and make sure they confirm there is no transfer charge hiding in the balance.

The resort has removed the airport transfer request and confirmed that no transfer fee was charged or remains pending. The 5:00 p.m. Thursday arrival is now an informational note only; the reservation terms were not changed.
And the massages? Their first summary made it look as though nothing had been paid.

The spa record has been linked to the stay and corrected: two concurrent massages on Monday at 3:00 p.m., total $573.40. The resort confirms $286.70 received and $286.70 due at the spa. Changes remain allowed through Sunday at 3:00 p.m.; after that, the full treatment amount is chargeable.
Give me the corrected itinerary and balances in one clean summary.

The corrected resort itinerary now shows Andaz Scottsdale for February 20–25 on the refundable breakfast package, with a 5:00 p.m. Thursday arrival note. The room total is $3,286.25; $600.25 has been paid, leaving $2,686 due under the booking terms. Cancellation remains penalty-free through February 13 at 6:00 p.m. resort local time. Two Monday 3:00 p.m. massages total $573.40; $286.70 is paid and $286.70 remains due at the spa. The airport transfer request is removed with a zero balance. The resort has issued the corrected itinerary and balance summary in writing.
